THE SOLUTION SUITE - macOS INSTALL
==================================

1. Close your DAW.
2. Copy the plugins:
     AU   folder contents -> ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/
     VST3 folder contents -> ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
     CLAP folder contents -> ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/
   (In Finder: Go menu > Go to Folder..., paste the path.)
3. These builds are not notarized by Apple, so macOS will block
   them at first. Open Terminal and run:
     xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins
4. Open your DAW and rescan plugins. In Logic, if a plugin shows
   as failed, use Plug-in Manager > Reset & Rescan Selection.

Works on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs (macOS 11 or newer).
